MAV_CMD_NAV_WAYPOINT.description: Navigate to waypoint. This is intended for use in missions (for guided commands outside of missions useMAV_CMD_DO_REPOSITION).

1 (Hold).type: Hold time. (ignored by fixed wing, time to stay at waypoint for rotary wing)

2 (Accept Radius).type: Acceptance radius (if the sphere with this radius is hit, the waypoint counts as reached)

3 (Pass Radius).type: 0 to pass through the WP, if > 0 radius to pass by WP. Positive value for clockwise orbit, negative value for counter-clockwise orbit. Allows trajectory control.

4 (Yaw).type: Desired yaw angle at waypoint (rotary wing). NaN to use the current system yaw heading mode (e.g. yaw towards next waypoint, yaw to home, etc.).

MAV_CMD_NAV_LOITER_UNLIM.description: Loiter around this waypoint an unlimited amount of time

3 (Radius).type: Loiter radius around waypoint for forward-only moving vehicles (not multicopters). If positive loiter clockwise, else counter-clockwise

4 (Yaw).type: Desired yaw angle. NaN to use the current system yaw heading mode (e.g. yaw towards next waypoint, yaw to home, etc.).

MAV_CMD_NAV_LOITER_TURNS.description: Loiter around this waypoint for X turns

2 (Heading Required).type: Leave loiter circle only when track heads towards the next waypoint (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: Leave when turns complete). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

3 (Radius).type: Loiter radius around waypoint for forward-only moving vehicles (not multicopters). If positive loiter clockwise, else counter-clockwise

4 (Xtrack Location).type: Loiter circle exit location and/or path to next waypoint ("xtrack") for forward-only moving vehicles (not multicopters). 0 for the vehicle to converge towards the center xtrack when it leaves the loiter (the line between the centers of the current and next waypoint), 1 to converge to the direct line between the location that the vehicle exits the loiter radius and the next waypoint. Otherwise the angle (in degrees) between the tangent of the loiter circle and the center xtrack at which the vehicle must leave the loiter (and converge to the center xtrack). NaN to use the current system default xtrack behaviour.

MAV_CMD_NAV_LOITER_TIME.description: Loiter at the specified latitude, longitude and altitude for a certain amount of time. Multicopter vehicles stop at the point (within a vehicle-specific acceptance radius). Forward-only moving vehicles (e.g. fixed-wing) circle the point with the specified radius/direction. If the Heading Required parameter (2) is non-zero forward moving aircraft will only leave the loiter circle once heading towards the next waypoint.

1 (Time).type: Loiter time (only starts once Lat, Lon and Alt is reached).

2 (Heading Required).type: Leave loiter circle only when track heading towards the next waypoint (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: Leave on time expiry). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

3 (Radius).type: Loiter radius around waypoint for forward-only moving vehicles (not multicopters). If positive loiter clockwise, else counter-clockwise.

4 (Xtrack Location).type: Loiter circle exit location and/or path to next waypoint ("xtrack") for forward-only moving vehicles (not multicopters). 0 for the vehicle to converge towards the center xtrack when it leaves the loiter (the line between the centers of the current and next waypoint), 1 to converge to the direct line between the location that the vehicle exits the loiter radius and the next waypoint. Otherwise the angle (in degrees) between the tangent of the loiter circle and the center xtrack at which the vehicle must leave the loiter (and converge to the center xtrack). NaN to use the current system default xtrack behaviour.

1 (Abort Alt).type: Minimum target altitude if landing is aborted (0 = undefined/use system default).

4 (Yaw Angle).type: Desired yaw angle. NaN to use the current system yaw heading mode (e.g. yaw towards next waypoint, yaw to home, etc.).

7 (Altitude).type: Landing altitude (ground level in current frame).

MAV_CMD_NAV_TAKEOFF.description: Takeoff from ground / hand. Vehicles that support multiple takeoff modes (e.g. VTOL quadplane) should take off using the currently configured mode.

1 (Pitch).type: Minimum pitch (if airspeed sensor present), desired pitch without sensor

4 (Yaw).type: Yaw angle (if magnetometer present), ignored without magnetometer. NaN to use the current system yaw heading mode (e.g. yaw towards next waypoint, yaw to home, etc.).

MAV_CMD_NAV_LAND_LOCAL.description: Land at local position (local frame only)

2 (Offset).type: Maximum accepted offset from desired landing position - computed magnitude from spherical coordinates: d = sqrt(x^2 + y^2 + z^2), which gives the maximum accepted distance between the desired landing position and the position where the vehicle is about to land

MAV_CMD_NAV_TAKEOFF_LOCAL.description: Takeoff from local position (local frame only)

1 (Pitch).type: Minimum pitch (if airspeed sensor present), desired pitch without sensor

4 (Yaw).type: Yaw angle (if magnetometer or another yaw estimation source present), ignored without one of these

MAV_CMD_NAV_FOLLOW.description: Vehicle following, i.e. this waypoint represents the position of a moving vehicle

1 (Following).type: Following logic to use (e.g. loitering or sinusoidal following) - depends on specific autopilot implementation

2 (Ground Speed).type: Ground speed of vehicle to be followed

3 (Radius).type: Radius around waypoint. If positive loiter clockwise, else counter-clockwise

MAV_CMD_NAV_CONTINUE_AND_CHANGE_ALT.description: Continue on the current course and climb/descend to specified altitude. When the altitude is reached continue to the next command (i.e., don't proceed to the next command until the desired altitude is reached.

1 (Action).type: Climb or Descend (0 = Neutral, command completes when within 5m of this command's altitude, 1 = Climbing, command completes when at or above this command's altitude, 2 = Descending, command completes when at or below this command's altitude.

MAV_CMD_NAV_LOITER_TO_ALT.description: Begin loiter at the specified Latitude and Longitude. If Lat=Lon=0, then loiter at the current position. Don't consider the navigation command complete (don't leave loiter) until the altitude has been reached. Additionally, if the Heading Required parameter is non-zero the aircraft will not leave the loiter until heading toward the next waypoint.

1 (Heading Required).type: Leave loiter circle only when track heading towards the next waypoint (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: Leave when altitude reached). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

2 (Radius).type: Loiter radius around waypoint for forward-only moving vehicles (not multicopters). If positive loiter clockwise, negative counter-clockwise, 0 means no change to standard loiter.

4 (Xtrack Location).type: Loiter circle exit location and/or path to next waypoint ("xtrack") for forward-only moving vehicles (not multicopters). 0 for the vehicle to converge towards the center xtrack when it leaves the loiter (the line between the centers of the current and next waypoint), 1 to converge to the direct line between the location that the vehicle exits the loiter radius and the next waypoint. Otherwise the angle (in degrees) between the tangent of the loiter circle and the center xtrack at which the vehicle must leave the loiter (and converge to the center xtrack). NaN to use the current system default xtrack behaviour.

1 (System ID).type: System ID (of the FOLLOW_TARGET beacon). Send 0 to disable follow-me and return to the default position hold mode.

4 (Altitude Mode).type: Altitude mode: 0: Keep current altitude, 1: keep altitude difference to target, 2: go to a fixed altitude above home.

7 (Time to Land).type: Time to land in which the MAV should go to the default position hold mode after a message RX timeout.

MAV_CMD_DO_FOLLOW_REPOSITION.description: Reposition the MAV after a follow target command has been sent

1 (Camera Q1).type: Camera q1 (where 0 is on the ray from the camera to the tracking device)

MAV_CMD_DO_ORBIT.description: Start orbiting on the circumference of a circle defined by the parameters. Setting values to NaN/INT32_MAX (as appropriate) results in using defaults.

1 (Radius).type: Radius of the circle. Positive: orbit clockwise. Negative: orbit counter-clockwise. NaN: Use vehicle default radius, or current radius if already orbiting.

2 (Velocity).type: Tangential Velocity. NaN: Use vehicle default velocity, or current velocity if already orbiting.

4 (Orbits).type: Orbit around the centre point for this many radians (i.e. for a three-quarter orbit set 270*Pi/180). 0: Orbit forever. NaN: Use vehicle default, or current value if already orbiting.

5 (Latitude/X).type: Center point latitude (if no MAV_FRAME specified) / X coordinate according to MAV_FRAME. INT32_MAX (or NaN if sent in COMMAND_LONG): Use current vehicle position, or current center if already orbiting.

6 (Longitude/Y).type: Center point longitude (if no MAV_FRAME specified) / Y coordinate according to MAV_FRAME. INT32_MAX (or NaN if sent in COMMAND_LONG): Use current vehicle position, or current center if already orbiting.

7 (Altitude/Z).type: Center point altitude (MSL) (if no MAV_FRAME specified) / Z coordinate according to MAV_FRAME. NaN: Use current vehicle altitude.

MAV_CMD_NAV_ROI.description: Sets the region of interest (ROI) for a sensor set or the vehicle itself. This can then be used by the vehicle's control system to control the vehicle attitude and the attitude of various sensors such as cameras.

2 (WP Index).type: Waypoint index/ target ID. (see MAV_ROI enum)

3 (ROI Index).type: ROI index (allows a vehicle to manage multiple ROI's)

5 (X).type: x the location of the fixed ROI (see MAV_FRAME)

MAV_CMD_NAV_PATHPLANNING.description: Control autonomous path planning on the MAV.

1 (Local Ctrl).type: 0: Disable local obstacle avoidance / local path planning (without resetting map), 1: Enable local path planning, 2: Enable and reset local path planning

2 (Global Ctrl).type: 0: Disable full path planning (without resetting map), 1: Enable, 2: Enable and reset map/occupancy grid, 3: Enable and reset planned route, but not occupancy grid

MAV_CMD_NAV_SPLINE_WAYPOINT.description: Navigate to waypoint using a spline path.

1 (Hold).type: Hold time. (ignored by fixed wing, time to stay at waypoint for rotary wing)

MAV_CMD_NAV_VTOL_TAKEOFF.description: Takeoff from ground using VTOL mode, and transition to forward flight with specified heading. The command should be ignored by vehicles that dont support both VTOL and fixed-wing flight (multicopters, boats,etc.).

4 (Yaw Angle).type: Yaw angle. NaN to use the current system yaw heading mode (e.g. yaw towards next waypoint, yaw to home, etc.).

3 (Approach Altitude).type: Approach altitude (with the same reference as the Altitude field). NaN if unspecified.

4 (Yaw).type: Yaw angle. NaN to use the current system yaw heading mode (e.g. yaw towards next waypoint, yaw to home, etc.).

7 (Ground Altitude).type: Altitude (ground level) relative to the current coordinate frame. NaN to use system default landing altitude (ignore value).

MAV_CMD_NAV_GUIDED_ENABLE.description: Hand control over to an external controller

1 (Enable).type: Guided mode on (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: Off). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_NAV_DELAY.description: Delay the next navigation command a number of seconds or until a specified time

MAV_CMD_NAV_PAYLOAD_PLACE.description: Descend and place payload. Vehicle moves to specified location, descends until it detects a hanging payload has reached the ground, and then releases the payload. If ground is not detected before the reaching the maximum descent value (param1), the command will complete without releasing the payload.

MAV_CMD_NAV_LAST.description: NOP - This command is only used to mark the upper limit of the NAV/ACTION commands in the enumeration

MAV_CMD_CONDITION_CHANGE_ALT.description: Ascend/descend to target altitude at specified rate. Delay mission state machine until desired altitude reached.

MAV_CMD_CONDITION_DISTANCE.description: Delay mission state machine until within desired distance of next NAV point.

1 (Angle).type: target angle [0-360]. Absolute angles: 0 is north. Relative angle: 0 is initial yaw. Direction set by param3.

3 (Direction).type: direction: -1: counter clockwise, 0: shortest direction, 1: clockwise

4 (Relative).type: Relative offset (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: absolute angle). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_CONDITION_LAST.description: NOP - This command is only used to mark the upper limit of the CONDITION commands in the enumeration

1 (Mode).type: Mode flags. MAV_MODE values can be used to set some mode flag combinations.

2 (Custom Mode).type: Custom system-specific mode (see target autopilot specifications for mode information). If MAV_MODE_FLAG_CUSTOM_MODE_ENABLED is set in param1 (mode) this mode is used: otherwise the field is ignored.

3 (Custom Submode).type: Custom sub mode - this is system specific, please refer to the individual autopilot specifications for details.

MAV_CMD_DO_JUMP.description: Jump to the desired command in the mission list. Repeat this action only the specified number of times

MAV_CMD_DO_CHANGE_SPEED.description: Change speed and/or throttle set points. The value persists until it is overridden or there is a mode change

1 (Speed Type).type: Speed type of value set in param2 (such as airspeed, ground speed, and so on)

2 (Speed).type: Speed (-1 indicates no change, -2 indicates return to default vehicle speed)

3 (Throttle).type: Throttle (-1 indicates no change, -2 indicates return to default vehicle throttle value)

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_HOME.description: Sets the home position to either to the current position or a specified position. The home position is the default position that the system will return to and land on. The position is set automatically by the system during the takeoff (and may also be set using this command). Note: the current home position may be emitted in aHOME_POSITIONmessage on request (usingMAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGEwith param1=242).

1 (Use Current).type: Use current location (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: use specified location). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

2 (Roll).type: Roll angle (of surface). Range: -180..180 degrees. NAN or 0 means value not set. 0.01 indicates zero roll.

3 (Pitch).type: Pitch angle (of surface). Range: -90..90 degrees. NAN or 0 means value not set. 0.01 means zero pitch.

4 (Yaw).type: Yaw angle. NaN to use default heading. Range: -180..180 degrees.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_PARAMETER.description: Set a system parameter. Caution! Use of this command requires knowledge of the numeric enumeration value of the parameter.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_RELAY.description: Set a relay to a condition.

2 (Setting).type: Setting. (1=on, 0=off, others possible depending on system hardware)

MAV_CMD_DO_REPEAT_RELAY.description: Cycle a relay on and off for a desired number of cycles with a desired period.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_SERVO.description: Set a servo to a desired PWM value.

MAV_CMD_DO_REPEAT_SERVO.description: Cycle a between its nominal setting and a desired PWM for a desired number of cycles with a desired period.

1 (Terminate).type: Flight termination activated if > 0.5. Otherwise not activated and ACK with MAV_RESULT_FAILED.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ACTUATOR.description: Sets actuators (e.g. servos) to a desired value. The actuator numbers are mapped to specific outputs (e.g. on any MAIN or AUX PWM or UAVCAN) using a flight-stack specific mechanism (i.e. a parameter).

1 (Actuator 1).type: Actuator 1 value, scaled from [-1 to 1]. NaN to ignore.

2 (Actuator 2).type: Actuator 2 value, scaled from [-1 to 1]. NaN to ignore.

3 (Actuator 3).type: Actuator 3 value, scaled from [-1 to 1]. NaN to ignore.

4 (Actuator 4).type: Actuator 4 value, scaled from [-1 to 1]. NaN to ignore.

5 (Actuator 5).type: Actuator 5 value, scaled from [-1 to 1]. NaN to ignore.

6 (Actuator 6).type: Actuator 6 value, scaled from [-1 to 1]. NaN to ignore.

7 (Index).type: Index of actuator set (i.e if set to 1, Actuator 1 becomes Actuator 7)

MAV_CMD_DO_RETURN_PATH_START.description: WORK IN PROGRESS: Do not use in stable production environments (it may change).

MAV_CMD_DO_LAND_START.description: Mission item to mark the start of a mission landing pattern, or a command to land with a mission landing pattern.

5 (Latitude).type: Latitude for landing sequence selection, or 0 (see description). Ignored in commands (set 0).

6 (Longitude).type: Longitude for landing sequence selection, or 0 (see description). Ignored in commands (set 0).

7 (Altitude).type: Altitude for landing sequence selection, or 0 (see description). Ignored in commands (set 0).

MAV_CMD_DO_RALLY_LAND.description: Mission command to perform a landing from a rally point.

MAV_CMD_DO_GO_AROUND.description: Mission command to safely abort an autonomous landing.

MAV_CMD_DO_REPOSITION.description: Reposition the vehicle to a specific WGS84 global position. This command is intended for guided commands (for missions useMAV_CMD_NAV_WAYPOINTinstead).

1 (Speed).type: Ground speed, less than 0 (-1) for default

3 (Radius).type: Loiter radius for planes. Positive values only, direction is controlled by Yaw value. A value of zero or NaN is ignored.

4 (Yaw).type: Yaw heading (heading reference defined in Bitmask field). NaN to use the current system yaw heading mode (e.g. yaw towards next waypoint, yaw to home, etc.). For planes indicates loiter direction (0: clockwise, 1: counter clockwise)

MAV_CMD_DO_PAUSE_CONTINUE.description: If in a GPS controlled position mode, hold the current position or continue.

1 (Continue).type: Continue mission (MAV_BOOL_TRUE), Pause current mission or reposition command, hold current position (MAV_BOOL_FALSE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid. A VTOL capable vehicle should enter hover mode (multicopter and VTOL planes). A plane should loiter with the default loiter radius.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_REVERSE.description: Set moving direction to forward or reverse.

1 (Reverse).type: Reverse direction (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: Forward direction). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI_LOCATION.description: Sets the region of interest (ROI) to a location. This can then be used by the vehicle's control system to control the vehicle attitude and the attitude of various sensors such as cameras. This command can be sent to a gimbal manager but not to a gimbal device. A gimbal is not to react to this message.

1 (Gimbal device ID).type: Component ID of gimbal device to address (or 1-6 for non-MAVLink gimbal), 0 for all gimbal device components. Send command multiple times for more than one gimbal (but not all gimbals).

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI_WPNEXT_OFFSET.description: Sets the region of interest (ROI) to be toward next waypoint, with optional pitch/roll/yaw offset. This can then be used by the vehicle's control system to control the vehicle attitude and the attitude of various sensors such as cameras. This command can be sent to a gimbal manager but not to a gimbal device. A gimbal device is not to react to this message.

1 (Gimbal device ID).type: Component ID of gimbal device to address (or 1-6 for non-MAVLink gimbal), 0 for all gimbal device components. Send command multiple times for more than one gimbal (but not all gimbals).

5 (Pitch Offset).type: Pitch offset from next waypoint, positive pitching up

6 (Roll Offset).type: Roll offset from next waypoint, positive rolling to the right

7 (Yaw Offset).type: Yaw offset from next waypoint, positive yawing to the right

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI_NONE.description: Cancels any previous ROI command returning the vehicle/sensors to default flight characteristics. This can then be used by the vehicle's control system to control the vehicle attitude and the attitude of various sensors such as cameras. This command can be sent to a gimbal manager but not to a gimbal device. A gimbal device is not to react to this message. After this command the gimbal manager should go back to manual input if available, and otherwise assume a neutral position.

1 (Gimbal device ID).type: Component ID of gimbal device to address (or 1-6 for non-MAVLink gimbal), 0 for all gimbal device components. Send command multiple times for more than one gimbal (but not all gimbals).

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI_SYSID.description: Mount tracks system with specified system ID. Determination of target vehicle position may be done withGLOBAL_POSITION_INTor any other means. This command can be sent to a gimbal manager but not to a gimbal device. A gimbal device is not to react to this message.

2 (Gimbal device ID).type: Component ID of gimbal device to address (or 1-6 for non-MAVLink gimbal), 0 for all gimbal device components. Send command multiple times for more than one gimbal (but not all gimbals).

2 (Transmission).type: Transmission: 0: disabled, 1: enabled compressed, 2: enabled raw

3 (Interval).type: Transmission mode: 0: video stream, >0: single images every n seconds

4 (Recording).type: Recording: 0: disabled, 1: enabled compressed, 2: enabled raw

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_ROI.description: Sets the region of interest (ROI) for a sensor set or the vehicle itself. This can then be used by the vehicle's control system to control the vehicle attitude and the attitude of various sensors such as cameras.

2 (WP Index).type: Waypoint index/ target ID (depends on param 1).

3 (ROI Index).type: Region of interest index. (allows a vehicle to manage multiple ROI's)

5.type: MAV_ROI_WPNEXT: pitch offset from next waypoint, MAV_ROI_LOCATION: latitude

6.type: MAV_ROI_WPNEXT: roll offset from next waypoint, MAV_ROI_LOCATION: longitude

7.type: MAV_ROI_WPNEXT: yaw offset from next waypoint, MAV_ROI_LOCATION: altitude

MAV_CMD_DO_DIGICAM_CONFIGURE.description: Configure digital camera. This is a fallback message for systems that have not yet implementedPARAM_EXT_XXXmessages and camera definition files (seehttps://mavlink.io/en/services/camera_def.html).

1 (Mode).type: Modes: P, TV, AV, M, Etc.

2 (Shutter Speed).type: Shutter speed: Divisor number for one second.

7 (Engine Cut-off).type: Main engine cut-off time before camera trigger. (0 means no cut-off)

MAV_CMD_DO_DIGICAM_CONTROL.description: Control digital camera. This is a fallback message for systems that have not yet implementedPARAM_EXT_XXXmessages and camera definition files (seehttps://mavlink.io/en/services/camera_def.html).

3 (Zoom Relative).type: Zooming step value to offset zoom from the current position

7 (Shot ID).type: Test shot identifier. If set to 1, image will only be captured, but not counted towards internal frame count.

MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONFIGURE.description: Mission command to configure a camera or antenna mount

2 (Stabilize Roll).type: Stabilize roll (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

3 (Stabilize Pitch).type: Stabilize pitch (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

4 (Stabilize Yaw).type: Stabilize yaw (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

5 (Roll Input Mode).type: Roll input (0 = angle body frame, 1 = angular rate, 2 = angle absolute frame)

6 (Pitch Input Mode).type: Pitch input (0 = angle body frame, 1 = angular rate, 2 = angle absolute frame)

7 (Yaw Input Mode).type: Yaw input (0 = angle body frame, 1 = angular rate, 2 = angle absolute frame)

MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONTROL.description: Mission command to control a camera or antenna mount

1 (Pitch).type: pitch depending on mount mode (degrees or degrees/second depending on pitch input).

2 (Roll).type: roll depending on mount mode (degrees or degrees/second depending on roll input).

3 (Yaw).type: yaw depending on mount mode (degrees or degrees/second depending on yaw input).

5 (Latitude).type: latitude, set if appropriate mount mode.

6 (Longitude).type: longitude, set if appropriate mount mode.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST.description: Mission command to set camera trigger distance for this flight. The camera is triggered each time this distance is exceeded. This command can also be used to set the shutter integration time for the camera.

1 (Distance).type: Camera trigger distance. 0 to stop triggering.

2 (Shutter).type: Camera shutter integration time. -1 or 0 to ignore

3 (Trigger).type: Trigger camera once, immediately (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

4 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

MAV_CMD_DO_FENCE_ENABLE.description: Enable the geofence. This can be used in a mission or via the command protocol. The persistence/lifetime of the setting is undefined. Depending on flight stack implementation it may persist until superseded, or it may revert to a system default at the end of a mission. Flight stacks typically reset the setting to system defaults on reboot.

2 (Types).type: Fence types to enable or disable as a bitmask. 0: field is unused/all fences should be enabled or disabled (for compatibility reasons). Parameter is ignored if param1=2.

MAV_CMD_DO_PARACHUTE.description: Mission item/command to release a parachute or enable/disable auto release.

1 (Instance).type: Motor instance number (from 1 to max number of motors on the vehicle).

2 (Throttle Type).type: Throttle type (whether the Throttle Value in param3 is a percentage, PWM value, etc.)

4 (Timeout).type: Timeout between tests that are run in sequence.

5 (Motor Count).type: Motor count. Number of motors to test in sequence: 0/1=one motor, 2= two motors, etc. The Timeout (param4) is used between tests.

1 (Inverted).type: Inverted flight (MAV_BOOL_False: normal flight). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_DO_GRIPPER.description: Mission command to operate a gripper.

1 (Gripper ID).type: Gripper ID. 1-6 for an autopilot connected gripper. In missions this may be set to 1-6 for an autopilot gripper, or the gripper component id for a MAVLink gripper. 0 targets all grippers.

1 (Enable).type: Enable autotune (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: disable autotune). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

2 (Axis).type: Specify axes for which autotuning is enabled/disabled. 0 indicates the field is unused (for compatibility reasons). If 0 the autopilot will follow its default behaviour, which is usually to tune all axes.

MAV_CMD_NAV_SET_YAW_SPEED.description: Sets a desired vehicle turn angle and speed change.

1 (Yaw).type: Yaw angle to adjust steering by.

3 (Angle).type: Relative final angle (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: Absolute angle). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_INTERVAL.description: Mission command to set camera trigger interval for this flight. If triggering is enabled, the camera is triggered each time this interval expires. This command can also be used to set the shutter integration time for the camera.

1 (Trigger Cycle).type: Camera trigger cycle time. -1 or 0 to ignore.

2 (Shutter Integration).type: Camera shutter integration time. Should be less than trigger cycle time. -1 or 0 to ignore.

3 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

MAV_CMD_DO_MOUNT_CONTROL_QUAT.description: Mission command to control a camera or antenna mount, using a quaternion as reference.

1 (Q1).type: quaternion param q1, w (1 in null-rotation)

2 (Q2).type: quaternion param q2, x (0 in null-rotation)

3 (Q3).type: quaternion param q3, y (0 in null-rotation)

4 (Q4).type: quaternion param q4, z (0 in null-rotation)

1 (Timeout).type: Timeout - maximum time that external controller will be allowed to control vehicle. 0 means no timeout.

2 (Min Altitude).type: Altitude (MSL) min - if vehicle moves below this alt, the command will be aborted and the mission will continue. 0 means no lower altitude limit.

3 (Max Altitude).type: Altitude (MSL) max - if vehicle moves above this alt, the command will be aborted and the mission will continue. 0 means no upper altitude limit.

4 (Horiz. Move Limit).type: Horizontal move limit - if vehicle moves more than this distance from its location at the moment the command was executed, the command will be aborted and the mission will continue. 0 means no horizontal move limit.

MAV_CMD_DO_ENGINE_CONTROL.description: Control vehicle engine. This is interpreted by the vehicles engine controller to change the target engine state. It is intended for vehicles with internal combustion engines

1 (Start Engine).type: Start engine (MAV_BOOL_False: Stop engine). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

2 (Cold Start).type: Cold start engine (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: Warm start). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid. Controls use of choke where applicable

3 (Height Delay).type: Height delay. This is for commanding engine start only after the vehicle has gained the specified height. Used in VTOL vehicles during takeoff to start engine after the aircraft is off the ground. Zero for no delay.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_MISSION_CURRENT.description: Set the mission item with sequence number seq as the current item and emitMISSION_CURRENT(whether or not the mission number changed). If a mission is currently being executed, the system will continue to this new mission item on the shortest path, skipping any intermediate mission items. Note that mission jump repeat counters are not reset unless param2 is set (seeMAV_CMD_DO_JUMPparam2).

1 (Number).type: Mission sequence value to set. -1 for the current mission item (use to reset mission without changing current mission item).

2 (Reset Mission).type: Reset mission (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid. Resets jump counters to initial values and changes mission state "completed" to be "active" or "paused".

MAV_CMD_DO_LAST.description: NOP - This command is only used to mark the upper limit of the DO commands in the enumeration

MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_CALIBRATION.description: Trigger calibration. This command will be only accepted if in pre-flight mode. Except for Temperature Calibration, only one sensor should be set in a single message and all others should be zero.

2 (Magnetometer).type: Magnetometer calibration. Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

3 (Ground Pressure).type: Ground pressure calibration. Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

4 (Remote Control).type: 1: radio RC calibration, 2: RC trim calibration

5 (Accelerometer).type: 1: accelerometer calibration, 2: board level calibration, 3: accelerometer temperature calibration, 4: simple accelerometer calibration

6 (Compmot or Airspeed).type: 1: APM: compass/motor interference calibration (PX4: airspeed calibration, deprecated), 2: airspeed calibration

MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_SET_SENSOR_OFFSETS.description: Set sensor offsets. This command will be only accepted if in pre-flight mode.

1 (Sensor Type).type: Sensor to adjust the offsets for: 0: gyros, 1: accelerometer, 2: magnetometer, 3: barometer, 4: optical flow, 5: second magnetometer, 6: third magnetometer

2 (X Offset).type: X axis offset (or generic dimension 1), in the sensor's raw units

3 (Y Offset).type: Y axis offset (or generic dimension 2), in the sensor's raw units

4 (Z Offset).type: Z axis offset (or generic dimension 3), in the sensor's raw units

5 (4th Dimension).type: Generic dimension 4, in the sensor's raw units

6 (5th Dimension).type: Generic dimension 5, in the sensor's raw units

7 (6th Dimension).type: Generic dimension 6, in the sensor's raw units

MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_UAVCAN.description: Trigger UAVCAN configuration (actuator ID assignment and direction mapping). Note that this maps to the legacy UAVCAN v0 functionUAVCAN_ENUMERATE, which is intended to be executed just once during initial vehicle configuration (it is not a normal pre-flight command and has been poorly named).

1 (Actuator ID).type: 1: Trigger actuator ID assignment and direction mapping. 0: Cancel command.

MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_STORAGE.description: Request storage of different parameter values and logs. This command will be only accepted if in pre-flight mode.

1 (Parameter Storage).type: Action to perform on the persistent parameter storage

2 (Mission Storage).type: Action to perform on the persistent mission storage

3 (Logging Rate).type: Onboard logging: 0: Ignore, 1: Start default rate logging, -1: Stop logging, > 1: logging rate (e.g. set to 1000 for 1000 Hz logging)

MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_REBOOT_SHUTDOWN.description: Request the reboot or shutdown of system components.

2 (Companion).type: Action to take for onboard computer.

3 (Component Action).type: Action to take for component specified in param4.

4 (Component ID).type: MAVLink Component ID targeted in param3 (0 for all components).

6 (Conditions).type: Conditions under which reboot/shutdown is allowed.

7.type: WIP: ID (e.g. camera ID -1 for all IDs)

MAV_CMD_OVERRIDE_GOTO.description: Override current mission with command to pause mission, pause mission and move to position, continue/resume mission. When param 1 indicates that the mission is paused (MAV_GOTO_DO_HOLD), param 2 defines whether it holds in place or moves to another position.

1 (Continue).type: MAV_GOTO_DO_HOLD: pause mission and either hold or move to specified position (depending on param2), MAV_GOTO_DO_CONTINUE: resume mission.

2 (Position).type: MAV_GOTO_HOLD_AT_CURRENT_POSITION: hold at current position, MAV_GOTO_HOLD_AT_SPECIFIED_POSITION: hold at specified position.

MAV_CMD_OBLIQUE_SURVEY.description: Mission command to set a Camera Auto Mount Pivoting Oblique Survey (ReplacesCAM_TRIGG_DISTfor this purpose). The camera is triggered each time this distance is exceeded, then the mount moves to the next position. Params 4~6 set-up the angle limits and number of positions for oblique survey, where mount-enabled vehicles automatically roll the camera between shots to emulate an oblique camera setup (providing an increased HFOV). This command can also be used to set the shutter integration time for the camera.

1 (Distance).type: Camera trigger distance. 0 to stop triggering.

2 (Shutter).type: Camera shutter integration time. 0 to ignore

3 (Min Interval).type: The minimum interval in which the camera is capable of taking subsequent pictures repeatedly. 0 to ignore.

4 (Positions).type: Total number of roll positions at which the camera will capture photos (images captures spread evenly across the limits defined by param5).

5 (Roll Angle).type: Angle limits that the camera can be rolled to left and right of center.

6 (Pitch Angle).type: Fixed pitch angle that the camera will hold in oblique mode if the mount is actuated in the pitch axis.

MAV_CMD_DO_SET_STANDARD_MODE.description: Enable the specified standard MAVLink mode.

1 (First Item).type: first_item: the first mission item to run

2 (Last Item).type: last_item: the last mission item to run (after this item is run, the mission ends)

MAV_CMD_ACTUATOR_TEST.description: Actuator testing command. This is similar toMAV_CMD_DO_MOTOR_TESTbut operates on the level of output functions, i.e. it is possible to test Motor1 independent from which output it is configured on. Autopilots must NACK this command withMAV_RESULT_TEMPORARILY_REJECTEDwhile armed.

1 (Value).type: Output value: 1 means maximum positive output, 0 to center servos or minimum motor thrust (expected to spin), -1 for maximum negative (if not supported by the motors, i.e. motor is not reversible, smaller than 0 maps to NaN). And NaN maps to disarmed (stop the motors).

2 (Timeout).type: Timeout after which the test command expires and the output is restored to the previous value. A timeout has to be set for safety reasons. A timeout of 0 means to restore the previous value immediately.

1 (Arm).type: Arm (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: disarm). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

2 (Force).type: 0: arm-disarm unless prevented by safety checks (i.e. when landed), 21196: force arming/disarming (e.g. allow arming to override preflight checks and disarming in flight)

MAV_CMD_RUN_PREARM_CHECKS.description: Instructs a target system to run pre-arm checks.

MAV_CMD_ILLUMINATOR_ON_OFF.description: Turns illuminators ON/OFF. An illuminator is a light source that is used for lighting up dark areas external to the system: e.g. a torch or searchlight (as opposed to a light source for illuminating the system itself, e.g. an indicator light).

1 (Enable).type: Illuminators on/off (MAV_BOOL_TRUE: illuminators on). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_DO_ILLUMINATOR_CONFIGURE.description: Configures illuminator settings. An illuminator is a light source that is used for lighting up dark areas external to the system: e.g. a torch or searchlight (as opposed to a light source for illuminating the system itself, e.g. an indicator light).

3 (Strobe Period).type: Strobe period in seconds where 0 means strobing is not used

4 (Strobe Duty).type: Strobe duty cycle where 100% means it is on constantly and 0 means strobing is not used

MAV_CMD_GET_HOME_POSITION.description: Request the home position from the vehicle.

MAV_CMD_INJECT_FAILURE.description: Inject artificial failure for testing purposes. Note that autopilots should implement an additional protection before accepting this command such as a specific param setting.

1 (Failure unit).type: The unit which is affected by the failure.

2 (Failure type).type: The type how the failure manifests itself.

3 (Instance).type: Instance affected by failure (0 to signal all).

MAV_CMD_GET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL.description: Request the interval between messages for a particular MAVLink message ID. The receiver should ACK the command and then emit its response in aMESSAGE_INTERVALmessage.

MAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL.description: Set the interval between messages for a particular MAVLink message ID. This interface replacesREQUEST_DATA_STREAM.

2 (Interval).type: The interval between two messages. -1: disable. 0: request default rate (which may be zero).

3 (Req Param 3).type: Use for index ID, if required. Otherwise, the use of this parameter (if any) must be defined in the requested message. By default assumed not used (0). When used as an index ID, 0 means "all instances", "1" means the first instance in the sequence (the emitted message will have an id of 0 if message ids are 0-indexed, or 1 if index numbers start from one).

4 (Req Param 4).type: The use of this parameter (if any), must be defined in the requested message. By default assumed not used (0).

5 (Req Param 5).type: The use of this parameter (if any), must be defined in the requested message. By default assumed not used (0/NaN).

6 (Req Param 6).type: The use of this parameter (if any), must be defined in the requested message. By default assumed not used (0/NaN).

7 (Response Target).type: Target address of message stream (if message has target address fields). 0: Flight-stack default (recommended), 1: address of requester, 2: broadcast.

MAV_CMD_REQUEST_MESSAGE.description: Request the target system(s) emit a single instance of a specified message (i.e. a "one-shot" version ofMAV_CMD_SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL).

1 (Message ID).type: The MAVLink message ID of the requested message.

2 (Req Param 1).type: Use for index ID, if required. Otherwise, the use of this parameter (if any) must be defined in the requested message. By default assumed not used (0).

3 (Req Param 2).type: The use of this parameter (if any), must be defined in the requested message. By default assumed not used (0).

4 (Req Param 3).type: The use of this parameter (if any), must be defined in the requested message. By default assumed not used (0).

5 (Req Param 4).type: The use of this parameter (if any), must be defined in the requested message. By default assumed not used (0).

6 (Req Param 5).type: The use of this parameter (if any), must be defined in the requested message. By default assumed not used (0).

7 (Response Target).type: Target address for requested message (if message has target address fields). 0: Flight-stack default, 1: address of requester, 2: broadcast.

MAV_CMD_REQUEST_PROTOCOL_VERSION.description: Request MAVLink protocol version compatibility. All receivers should ACK the command and then emit their capabilities in anPROTOCOL_VERSIONmessage

1 (Protocol).type: Request supported protocol versions by all nodes on the network (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_REQUEST_AUTOPILOT_CAPABILITIES.description: Request autopilot capabilities. The receiver should ACK the command and then emit its capabilities in anAUTOPILOT_VERSIONmessage

1 (Version).type: Request autopilot version (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

1 (Capabilities).type: Request camera capabilities (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

1 (Settings).type: Request camera settings (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_REQUEST_STORAGE_INFORMATION.description: Request storage information (STORAGE_INFORMATION). Use the command's target_component to target a specific component's storage.

1 (Storage ID).type: Storage ID (0 for all, 1 for first, 2 for second, etc.)

2 (Information).type: Request storage information (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_STORAGE_FORMAT.description: Format a storage medium. Once format is complete, aSTORAGE_INFORMATIONmessage is sent. Use the command's target_component to target a specific component's storage.

1 (Storage ID).type: Storage ID (1 for first, 2 for second, etc.)

2 (Format).type: Format storage (and reset image log). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

3 (Reset Image Log).type: Reset Image Log (without formatting storage medium). This will reset CAMERA_CAPTURE_STATUS.image_count and CAMERA_IMAGE_CAPTURED.image_index. Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

1 (Capture Status).type: Request camera capture status (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

1 (Flight Information).type: Request flight information (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_RESET_CAMERA_SETTINGS.description: Reset all camera settings to Factory Default

1 (Reset).type: Reset all settings (MAV_BOOL_TRUE). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

2 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

MAV_CMD_SET_CAMERA_MODE.description: Set camera running mode. Use NaN for reserved values. GCS will send aMAV_CMD_REQUEST_VIDEO_STREAM_STATUScommand after a mode change if the camera supports video streaming.

1 (id).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

MAV_CMD_SET_CAMERA_ZOOM.description: Set camera zoom. Camera must respond with aCAMERA_SETTINGSmessage (on success).

2 (Zoom Value).type: Zoom value. The range of valid values depend on the zoom type.

3 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

MAV_CMD_SET_CAMERA_FOCUS.description: Set camera focus. Camera must respond with aCAMERA_SETTINGSmessage (on success).

3 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

MAV_CMD_SET_STORAGE_USAGE.description: Set that a particular storage is the preferred location for saving photos, videos, and/or other media (e.g. to set that an SD card is used for storing videos).

1 (Storage ID).type: Storage ID (1 for first, 2 for second, etc.)

MAV_CMD_SET_CAMERA_SOURCE.description: Set camera source. Changes the camera's active sources on cameras with multiple image sensors.

1 (device id).type: Component Id of camera to address or 1-6 for non-MAVLink cameras, 0 for all cameras.

3 (secondary source).type: Secondary Source. If non-zero the second source will be displayed as picture-in-picture.

MAV_CMD_JUMP_TAG.description: Tagged jump target. Can be jumped to withMAV_CMD_DO_JUMP_TAG.

MAV_CMD_DO_JUMP_TAG.description: Jump to the matching tag in the mission list. Repeat this action for the specified number of times. A mission should contain a single matching tag for each jump. If this is not the case then a jump to a missing tag should complete the mission, and a jump where there are multiple matching tags should always select the one with the lowest mission sequence number.

MAV_CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_PITCHYAW.description: Set gimbal manager pitch/yaw setpoints (low rate command). It is possible to set combinations of the values below. E.g. an angle as well as a desired angular rate can be used to get to this angle at a certain angular rate, or an angular rate only will result in continuous turning. NaN is to be used to signal unset. Note: only the gimbal manager will react to this command - it will be ignored by a gimbal device. UseGIMBAL_MANAGER_SET_PITCHYAWif you need to stream pitch/yaw setpoints at higher rate.

1 (Pitch angle).type: Pitch angle (positive to pitch up, relative to vehicle for FOLLOW mode, relative to world horizon for LOCK mode).

2 (Yaw angle).type: Yaw angle (positive to yaw to the right, relative to vehicle for FOLLOW mode, absolute to North for LOCK mode).

4 (Yaw rate).type: Yaw rate (positive to yaw to the right).

7 (Gimbal device ID).type: Component ID of gimbal device to address (or 1-6 for non-MAVLink gimbal), 0 for all gimbal device components. Send command multiple times for more than one gimbal (but not all gimbals).

MAV_CMD_DO_GIMBAL_MANAGER_CONFIGURE.description: Gimbal configuration to set which sysid/compid is in primary and secondary control.

1 (sysid primary control).type: Sysid for primary control (0: no one in control, -1: leave unchanged, -2: set itself in control (for missions where the own sysid is still unknown), -3: remove control if currently in control).

2 (compid primary control).type: Compid for primary control (0: no one in control, -1: leave unchanged, -2: set itself in control (for missions where the own sysid is still unknown), -3: remove control if currently in control).

3 (sysid secondary control).type: Sysid for secondary control (0: no one in control, -1: leave unchanged, -2: set itself in control (for missions where the own sysid is still unknown), -3: remove control if currently in control).

4 (compid secondary control).type: Compid for secondary control (0: no one in control, -1: leave unchanged, -2: set itself in control (for missions where the own sysid is still unknown), -3: remove control if currently in control).

7 (Gimbal device ID).type: Component ID of gimbal device to address (or 1-6 for non-MAVLink gimbal), 0 for all gimbal device components. Send command multiple times for more than one gimbal (but not all gimbals).

MAV_CMD_IMAGE_START_CAPTURE.description: Start image capture sequence.CAMERA_IMAGE_CAPTUREDmust be emitted after each capture.

1 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

2 (Interval).type: Desired elapsed time between two consecutive pictures (in seconds). Minimum values depend on hardware (typically greater than 2 seconds).

3 (Total Images).type: Total number of images to capture. 0 to capture forever/until MAV_CMD_IMAGE_STOP_CAPTURE.

4 (Sequence Number).type: Capture sequence number starting from 1. This is only valid for single-capture (param3 == 1), otherwise set to 0. Increment the capture ID for each capture command to prevent double captures when a command is re-transmitted.

1 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

1 (Number).type: Sequence number for missing CAMERA_IMAGE_CAPTURED message

MAV_CMD_DO_TRIGGER_CONTROL.description: Enable or disable on-board camera triggering system.

1 (Enable).type: Trigger enable/disable (0 for disable, 1 for start), -1 to ignore

2 (Reset).type: 1 to reset the trigger sequence, -1 or 0 to ignore

3 (Pause).type: 1 to pause triggering, but without switching the camera off or retracting it. -1 to ignore

4 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

MAV_CMD_CAMERA_TRACK_POINT.description: If the camera supports point visual tracking (CAMERA_CAP_FLAGS_HAS_TRACKING_POINTis set), this command allows to initiate the tracking.

1 (Point x).type: Point to track x value (normalized 0..1, 0 is left, 1 is right).

2 (Point y).type: Point to track y value (normalized 0..1, 0 is top, 1 is bottom).

3 (Radius).type: Point radius (normalized 0..1, 0 is one pixel, 1 is full image width).

4 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

MAV_CMD_CAMERA_TRACK_RECTANGLE.description: If the camera supports rectangle visual tracking (CAMERA_CAP_FLAGS_HAS_TRACKING_RECTANGLEis set), this command allows to initiate the tracking.

1 (Top left corner x).type: Top left corner of rectangle x value (normalized 0..1, 0 is left, 1 is right).

2 (Top left corner y).type: Top left corner of rectangle y value (normalized 0..1, 0 is top, 1 is bottom).

3 (Bottom right corner x).type: Bottom right corner of rectangle x value (normalized 0..1, 0 is left, 1 is right).

4 (Bottom right corner y).type: Bottom right corner of rectangle y value (normalized 0..1, 0 is top, 1 is bottom).

5 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

1 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

1 (Stream ID).type: Video Stream ID (0 for all streams)

2 (Status Frequency).type: Frequency CAMERA_CAPTURE_STATUS messages should be sent while recording (0 for no messages, otherwise frequency)

3 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

1 (Stream ID).type: Video Stream ID (0 for all streams)

2 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

1 (Stream ID).type: Video Stream ID (0 for all streams, 1 for first, 2 for second, etc.)

2 (Target Camera ID).type: Target camera ID. 7 to 255: MAVLink camera component id. 1 to 6 for cameras attached to the autopilot, which don't have a distinct component id. 0: all cameras. This is used to target specific autopilot-connected cameras. It is also used to target specific cameras when the MAV_CMD is used in a mission.

Video Stream ID (0 for all streams, 1 for first, 2 for second, etc.)

MAV_CMD_LOGGING_START.description: Request to start streaming logging data over MAVLink (see alsoLOGGING_DATAmessage)

MAV_CMD_LOGGING_STOP.description: Request to stop streaming log data over MAVLink

MAV_CMD_AIRFRAME_CONFIGURATION.description: Request to start/stop transmitting over the high latency telemetry

2 (Landing Gear Position).type: Landing gear position (Down: 0, Up: 1, NaN for no change)

MAV_CMD_CONTROL_HIGH_LATENCY.description: Request to start/stop transmitting over the high latency telemetry

1 (Enable).type: Start transmission over high latency telemetry (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: stop transmission). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_PANORAMA_CREATE.description: Create a panorama at the current position

1 (Horizontal Angle).type: Viewing angle horizontal of the panorama (+- 0.5 the total angle)

1 (State).type: The target VTOL state. For normal transitions, only MAV_VTOL_STATE_MC and MAV_VTOL_STATE_FW can be used.

2 (Immediate).type: Force immediate transition to the specified MAV_VTOL_STATE. 1: Force immediate, 0: normal transition. Can be used, for example, to trigger an emergency "Quadchute". Caution: Can be dangerous/damage vehicle, depending on autopilot implementation of this command.

MAV_CMD_ARM_AUTHORIZATION_REQUEST.description: Request authorization to arm the vehicle to a external entity, the arm authorizer is responsible to request all data that is needs from the vehicle before authorize or deny the request.

1 (System ID).type: Vehicle system id, this way ground station can request arm authorization on behalf of any vehicle

MAV_CMD_SET_GUIDED_SUBMODE_STANDARD.description: This command sets the submode to standard guided when vehicle is in guided mode. The vehicle holds position and altitude and the user can input the desired velocities along all three axes.

MAV_CMD_SET_GUIDED_SUBMODE_CIRCLE.description: This command sets submode circle when vehicle is in guided mode. Vehicle flies along a circle facing the center of the circle. The user can input the velocity along the circle and change the radius. If no input is given the vehicle will hold position.

1 (Radius).type: Radius of desired circle in CIRCLE_MODE

5 (Latitude).type: Target latitude of center of circle in CIRCLE_MODE

6 (Longitude).type: Target longitude of center of circle in CIRCLE_MODE

MAV_CMD_CONDITION_GATE.description: WORK IN PROGRESS: Do not use in stable production environments (it may change).

1 (Geometry).type: Geometry: 0: orthogonal to path between previous and next waypoint.

2 (UseAltitude).type: Use altitude (MAV_BOOL_FALSE: ignore altitude). Values not equal to 0 or 1 are invalid.

MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_RETURN_POINT.description: Fence return point (there can only be one such point in a geofence definition). If rally points are supported they should be used instead.

MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_POLYGON_VERTEX_INCLUSI.description: Fence vertex for an inclusion polygon (the polygon must not be self-intersecting). The vehicle must stay within this area. Minimum of 3 vertices required.

1 (Vertex Count).type: Polygon vertex count. This is the number of vertices in the current polygon (all vertices will have the same number).

2 (Inclusion Group).type: Vehicle must be inside ALL inclusion zones in a single group, vehicle must be inside at least one group, must be the same for all points in each polygon

MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_POLYGON_VERTEX_EXCLUSI.description: Fence vertex for an exclusion polygon (the polygon must not be self-intersecting). The vehicle must stay outside this area. Minimum of 3 vertices required.

1 (Vertex Count).type: Polygon vertex count. This is the number of vertices in the current polygon (all vertices will have the same number).

MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_CIRCLE_INCLUSION.description: Circular fence area. The vehicle must stay inside this area.

2 (Inclusion Group).type: Vehicle must be inside ALL inclusion zones in a single group, vehicle must be inside at least one group

MAV_CMD_NAV_FENCE_CIRCLE_EXCLUSION.description: Circular fence area. The vehicle must stay outside this area.

MAV_CMD_NAV_RALLY_POINT.description: Rally point. You can have multiple rally points defined.

MAV_CMD_UAVCAN_GET_NODE_INFO.description: Commands the vehicle to respond with a sequence of messagesUAVCAN_NODE_INFO, one message per every UAVCAN node that is online.
